comment: Compat tests that give different answers on identical input. Quarantined from the baseline gate in BOTH directions: a flaky test never fails a PR, and never gets promoted on the run where it happened to pass. Quarantine is a STOP-GAP — every entry needs a tracking issue and a date, goes overdue after 14 days (the nightly flake-detection job fails), and blocks pull requests after 30 (the PR lint fails). Fix the test and delete the entry. See compat/AGENTS.md § Stabilising a flaky test.

flaky.reason: Intermittent 'Topic does not exist: oc-<run>-dn-sns-sub'. The same topic was used successfully by SubscribeSQS earlier in the group, so the topic is being lost between calls rather than never created — suspect write visibility in internal/state, or a handler reading a snapshot taken before the write landed. Observed passing and failing on consecutive CI runs of an unchanged tree.
Cascades from PublishDeliveredToSQS: reported 'skip — dependency failed' on some runs and 'fail' on others. Not flaky in itself; remove it together with the entry above.

Downstream of the stable cli/eventbridge-buses/ListEventBuses failure (plan R7), whose knock-on is not deterministic: 'skip — dependency failed' on some runs, 'fail' on others, on trees that do not touch EventBridge. Not flaky in itself; remove it with the ListEventBuses fix. Same shape as the SNS race above — a resource is created, and the next call cannot find it — which is why one issue covers both.
